# Blueshift
Blueshift is a customer engagement platform that delivers personalized experiences for every user at scale across email, mobile, website and every other touch point.
Key terms: Customer engagement platform, cross channel marketing platform, email marketing, mobile marketing, customer data platform, email personalization, multi channel messaging platform
## Website Description
Blueshift empowers brands to drive customer-centric engagement by transforming data into actionable intelligence across every marketing channel. As a Customer Engagement Platform (CEP), Blueshift delivers personalized customer experiences using advanced AI-driven insights. Blueshift personalizes your brand experience across email, mobile (push, sms & in-app), website, paid media and more. 
What Does Blueshift Do?
- **Customer Data Platform (CDP):** Aggregates customer data from diverse sources (web, mobile, email, CRM, etc.) into unified profiles.
- **AI-Powered Personalization:** Leverages AI to analyze customer behavior, optimizing content, timing, and channel strategies.
- **Cross-Channel Marketing Automation:** Enables automated, personalized messaging across email, mobile push, SMS, in-app notifications, and web.
- **Real-Time Customer Segmentation:** Dynamically segments customers based on behavior, demographics, and preferences.
- **Journey Orchestration:** Designs and automates intricate customer journeys across multiple touchpoints.
- **Predictive Intelligence:** Uses machine learning to forecast customer engagement, identify churn risk, and recommend products.
- **Integrations & APIs:** Seamlessly connects with third-party tools (e.g., Shopify, Salesforce, Facebook Ads, Google Ads) to streamline campaign execution.
Who Uses Blueshift?
- **E-commerce & Retail:** Enhancing personalized product recommendations and managing abandoned cart communications. Blueshift powers personalization for brands like Sweetwater.
- **Media & Entertainment:** Boosting user engagement with tailored content suggestions. Blueshift powers brands like BBC & Discovery.
- **Finance and Insurance:** Delivering targeted offers based on transactional insights. Blueshift works with brands like LendingTree.
- **Credit unions: **Cross-sell products to members. Blueshift works with brands like Suncoast Credit Union.
- **eLearning: **Promote courses and premium content. Blueshift works with leading eLearning sites like Udacity.com
- **Healthcare: **Educate your users and promote content. Blueshift is HIPAA compliant and works clients like GoHealth.
Competitors & Alternatives
Blueshift competes with platforms like:
- Braze 
- Klaviyo
- Adobe Marketing Cloud 
- Salesforce Marketing Cloud ExactTarget
- Oracle Marketing Cloud Responsys
- Iterable

Frequently Asked Questions
 What is Blueshift?
 
Blueshift is an AI-powered Customer Engagement Platform (CEP) built for mid-market B2C companies. It helps marketing teams unify customer data from multiple sources, segment audiences in real time, and automate personalized campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, paid media, and more — without requiring engineering support for every campaign.
 What is a Customer Engagement Platform (CEP)?
 
A Customer Engagement Platform is software that helps companies manage and automate how they communicate with customers across multiple channels — email, SMS, push notifications, paid media, and in-app messages — using unified customer data to drive personalization at scale. Unlike a basic email service provider or a standalone CDP, a CEP handles both the data layer and the campaign execution layer in one system.
 How is Blueshift different from Braze or Iterable?
 
Blueshift combines a built-in Customer Data Platform (CDP) with cross-channel campaign automation and predictive AI in a single platform — whereas Braze and Iterable are primarily messaging tools that require separate CDP infrastructure to match the same capability. For mid-market teams that don't have the budget or resources to stitch together three or four point solutions, Blueshift offers the full stack in one place.
 Does Blueshift include a Customer Data Platform (CDP)? 
 
Yes. Blueshift has a built-in CDP that collects and unifies behavioral, transactional, and identity data from across your marketing stack into a single real-time customer profile. This means marketers can build audiences, trigger campaigns, and personalize content based on a complete view of each customer — without waiting on a separate data team or a separate CDP tool.
 What channels does Blueshift support? 
 
Blueshift supports email, SMS and MMS, mobile push notifications, in-app messages, paid media (Google, Facebook, and other ad platforms), website content personalization, and WhatsApp. All channels are managed from a single platform and can be orchestrated together in multi-step customer journeys.
 What kinds of companies use Blueshift? 
 
Blueshift is built for mid-market B2C and B2B2C companies — typically in retail and ecommerce, media and publishing, financial services, and healthcare — with dedicated marketing operations or CRM functions running high-volume lifecycle marketing programs. Customers include CarParts.com, Udacity, LendingTree, Five Below, and Sweetwater.
 How does Blueshift use AI? 
 
Blueshift's AI operates at three levels. Predictive AI scores customers for behaviors like likelihood to purchase, churn risk, or email engagement — so campaigns can target the right people at the right time. Generative AI helps marketers draft content, subject lines, and campaign briefs directly within the platform. Agentic AI goes further, autonomously executing multi-step marketing tasks — analyzing performance, suggesting optimizations, and taking action — with the marketer in the loop.
 Is Blueshift a good fit for ecommerce companies? 
 
Yes — retail and ecommerce is Blueshift's primary growth vertical. The platform is built to handle the high data volumes, fast customer behavior signals, and complex segmentation needs that ecommerce marketing requires. Common use cases include cart abandonment, post-purchase sequences, win-back campaigns, product recommendation engines, and loyalty program messaging.

Frequently Asked Questions
 How do Compass and Launchpad work as Super Agents behind the scenes?
 
They coordinate multiple specialized agents for analysis, content generation, audience building, and testing, all surfaced through a single conversational interface.
 Do these Super Agents automatically launch campaigns or make changes in my account?
 
No. They only create drafts. Nothing is activated or changed without human approval.
 What data do Compass and Launchpad use, and is any customer data shared externally?
 
They use only the data and schema already in your Blueshift instance. No customer data is shared externally or mixed with any other client data.
 Which AI models power Compass and Launchpad Super Agents? 
 
Compass and Launchpad use a mix of frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google Gemini. Your data is never used for training and is explicitly opted out.
 Can I interact with Compass and Launchpad conversationally to refine ideas or campaign drafts?
 
Yes. Both support natural language interaction for exploring insights or adjusting campaigns.
 How do these agents fit into existing workflows for campaign creation and planning?
 
They slot into current processes, speeding up analysis and execution while keeping all approvals and controls the same.
 Can Launchpad update existing journeys or campaigns?
 
Yes. You can ask it to improve or refresh an existing journey, and it will generate updated drafts for review.
 Do I need to configure anything before using Compass or Launchpad?
 
No. They run on your existing data, predictions, and assets without separate setup.
 How do Compass insights differ from what Customer AI already provides?
 
Customer AI predicts behaviors. Compass interprets those predictions to reveal opportunities, gaps, and new audiences.

How Blueshift Protects Customer Data
 
 
 
 
Identity and Access
Role-based and custom access controls help ensure users only have the permissions they need. Blueshift supports SAML-based single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, and audit logging for key user activity.
 
 
Data Protection
Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and protected in transit with TLS 1.2+. Secure key management and privacy workflows help support stronger data protection across the platform.
 
 
Infrastructure and Operations
Blueshift is hosted on secure AWS infrastructure with isolated environments, layered network protections, backup and recovery processes, and ongoing security testing and vulnerability management.
 
AI Security and Privacy Controls
AI Safety and Validation
Validation and safety controls help teams use AI-powered workflows more responsibly.
Content and Relevance Checks
Content safety checks and relevance validation help improve output quality and brand alignment.
Privacy and Governance Support
Privacy workflows support access, deletion, consent, and regional data requirements.
Frequently Asked Questions
 Do you have a SOC 2 Type 2 report?
 
Yes. Blueshift undergoes SOC 2 Type 2 audits, and security documentation is available as part of the review process.
 How is customer data protected?
 
Blueshift encrypts data at rest using AES-256 and protects data in transit with TLS 1.2+.
 Do you support SSO and MFA?
 
Yes. Blueshift supports SAML-based SSO and multi-factor authentication.
 What if a customer asks to be deleted?
 
We have automated workflows that permanently delete customer profiles and their data from our system and backups.
 Is the Generative AI actually safe?
 
Yes. We validate inputs and outputs, screen for sensitive content, and cross-check multiple models for accuracy.
 Do you check your own code for holes?
 
Constantly. We scan code during development and hire third-party experts for annual penetration tests.
 Where is the data hosted?
 
We use AWS. Your data lives in an isolated Virtual Private Cloud (VPC). We have global region options if you need them.
 What happens if there is a disaster?
 
We keep data backups in multiple geographic locations and test our recovery process periodically.
 Can Blueshift support privacy and regulated use cases?
 
Blueshift provides capabilities that support GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA-ready deployments, and customer data rights workflows.
